summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EduNet Messages/Communications Module. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified all 3 tabs (Chats, Escribir, Grupos), user selector with role grouping, WhatsApp-style chat view, mail inbox with filters, and attachment support.
passed_tests: GET /api/messages/users - Returns users grouped by role (Directores, Profesores, Padres)
GET /api/messages/users - Excludes current user from list
GET /api/messages/chats - Returns chat conversations list
POST /api/messages/chats/send - Sends chat message successfully
POST /api/messages/chats/send - Returns 404 for invalid receiver
GET /api/messages/chats/{user_id} - Returns chat history with partner
GET /api/messages/chats/{user_id} - Returns 404 for invalid user
GET /api/messages/inbox - Returns mail messages
GET /api/messages/inbox?type=received - Filters received messages
GET /api/messages/inbox?type=sent - Filters sent messages
POST /api/messages/send - Sends mail message with subject
POST /api/messages/send - Returns 400 when subject missing
PUT /api/messages/{id}/read - Marks message as read
GET /api/messages/unread-count - Returns unread count
DELETE /api/messages/{id} - Deletes message sent by user
DELETE /api/messages/{id} - Returns 404 for non-owned message
Integration: Complete chat flow (get users -> send -> verify in list -> verify in history)
Integration: Complete mail flow (send -> verify in inbox -> delete)
Frontend: Messages page loads at /school/demosettings/mensajes
Frontend: 3 tabs present (Chats, Escribir, Grupos)
Frontend: Chats tab shows conversation list
Frontend: Chat view opens with WhatsApp-style bubbles
Frontend: Chat shows partner name, role, photo
Frontend: Message input and send button work
Frontend: Escribir tab shows mail form
Frontend: User selector dropdown with role groups (Directores, Profesores)
Frontend: User selector has search functionality
Frontend: Bandeja de Entrada shows sent messages
Frontend: Inbox filters (Todos, Recibidos, Enviados) present
Frontend: Grupos tab shows 'Próximamente' placeholder
Frontend: 'Iniciar nuevo chat' opens user selector
